shields_note: The AUAOF line reads 'the shields are don't do that again and whatever turns you on for the other nine'; Don't Do That Again is named there and Aim High is named as a shield in the strategy (Hunt Down matchup); the rest are unnamed.
notes: The byline 'Legolas Greenleaf' is a fictional name, so the deck is credited to the DeckTech handle Legolas_ (plain text, no person page); the post is signed 'Me, Myself, and I'.

Starting (6) as posted: Tatooine: Slave Quarters (starting location; no objective), An Unusual Amount Of Fear, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Battle Plan & Draw Their Fire, Scrambled Transmission, Your Insight Serves You Well & Staging Areas; all count toward the total.

The list totals 59 as published: the Starships header says 3 but only Spiral and one Millennium Falcon are listed (the strategy mentions '2 Falcons'), and the Effects header says 8 but 7 lines are listed.
Posted 'Y IV Massassi ? (whichever one is the twix)' is kept as written: both Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins and Yavin 4: Massassi Headquarters are 2/0 Light sites of the era, so the card can't be told.
Posted 'Affect Mind or Bacta Tank (your pick)' dested Affect Mind, the card the strategy argues for ('Affect mind is tech'); Bacta Tank is the stated alternative.

Posted 'The Naked Droid' dested C-3PO (See-Threepio) (the strategy: 'pull Shmi who pulls Threepio'); 'LS,JK' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'EPP' Qui-Gon, Obi, Han and Leia dested the Enhanced Premiere characters; 'SATM' dested Sorry About The Mess; 'Endor CC's Hut' dested Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut; 'Honor' dested Honor Of The Jedi.
Posted 'Alter/FF', 'Sense/RIF', 'Houjix/OON', 'SI/Grimtaash', 'Battle Plan/DTF' and 'YISYW/SA' dested the combo cards.
